    folds := integer(rows[6][1])
    uncertain := number(rows[7][1])

class Input(string[] ids, real64[][] points, real64[][][] initial, Settings settings)

Input read_inputs()
    string[] ids := []
    real64[][] points := []
    rows := lines("input/points.csv")
    for row := rows[1:<int(#rows)][]
        fields := row.split(",")
        ids = ids.append(fields[0])
        points = points.append([number(fields[1]), number(fields[2])])
    real64[][][] initial := [[], [], [], [], []]
    count := 0
    real64[] weights := []
    for row := lines("input/init.txt")[]
        if row == ""
            continue
        fields := row.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "K"
            count = integer(fields[1])
        elif fields[0] == "W"
            weights = [for text := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then number(text)]
        else
            component := integer(fields[1]) - 1
            values := [weights[component]]
            for: 2 <= j < 7
                values = values.append(number(fields[j]))
            initial[count] = initial[count].append(values)
    parameters := [for row := lines("input/params.txt")[] then row.split(" ")]
    return Input(ids, points, initial, Settings(parameters))

import math
import gaussian = "./gaussian.qui"

real64[][] adjust(real64[][] initial, string kind)
    model := initial
    real64[] shared := [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    if kind == "TIED"
        for: column < 3
            for component := initial[]
                shared[column] += component[0] * component[column + 3]
    for &component := &model[]
        if kind == "DIAG"
            component[4] = 0.0
        elif kind == "SPHERICAL"
            variance := (component[3] + component[5]) / 2.0
            component[3] = variance
            component[4] = 0.0
            component[5] = variance
        elif kind == "TIED"
            for: column < 3
                component[column + 3] = shared[column]
    return model

(real64[][], real64[], real64) expectation(real64[][] points, real64[][] model)
    real64[][] records := []
    real64[] densities := []
    real64 loglik := 0.0
    for point := points[]
        real64[] scores := []
        real64 maximum := -inf
        for component := model[]
            score := gaussian.log_density(point, component)
            scores = scores.append(score)
            if score > maximum
                maximum = score
        real64[] row := []
        real64 total := 0.0
        for score := scores[]
            value := math.exp(score - maximum)
            row = row.append(value)
            total += value
        for &value := &row[]
            value /= total
        logarithm := math.log(total)
        density := maximum + logarithm
        records = records.append(row)
        densities = densities.append(density)
        loglik += density
    return (records, densities, loglik)

real64[][] maximization(real64[][] points, real64[][] records, string kind, real64 epsilon)
    count := int(#records[0])
    sample_size := real64(#points)
    real64[][] model := []
    real64[] counts := []
    real64[][] scatters := []
    for: k < count
        real64 nk := 0.0
        real64 sx := 0.0
        real64 sy := 0.0
        for: i < int(#points)
            r := records[i][k]
            nk += r
            sx += r * points[i][0]
            sy += r * points[i][1]
        mx := sx / nk
        my := sy / nk
        counts = counts.append(nk)
        model = model.append([nk / sample_size, mx, my, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
        real64 a := 0.0
        real64 b := 0.0
        real64 c := 0.0
        for: i < int(#points)
            dx := points[i][0] - mx
            dy := points[i][1] - my
            r := records[i][k]
            a += r * dx * dx
            b += r * dx * dy
            c += r * dy * dy
        scatters = scatters.append([a, b, c])
    if kind == "TIED"
        real64[] shared := [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        for: column < 3
            for scatter := scatters[]
                shared[column] += scatter[column]
            shared[column] /= sample_size
        shared[0] += epsilon
        shared[2] += epsilon
        for: k < count
            for: column < 3
                model[k][column + 3] = shared[column]
    else
        for: k < count
            a := scatters[k][0] / counts[k] + epsilon
            b := if kind == "FULL" then scatters[k][1] / counts[k] else 0.0
            c := scatters[k][2] / counts[k] + epsilon
            if kind == "SPHERICAL"
                variance := (scatters[k][0] / counts[k] + scatters[k][2] / counts[k]) / 2.0 + epsilon
                a = variance
                c = variance
            model[k][3] = a
            model[k][4] = b
            model[k][5] = c
    return model

(real64[][], real64[][], real64[], real64[]) run(real64[][] points, real64[][] initial, string kind, int iterations, real64 epsilon)
    model := adjust(initial, kind)
    records, densities, loglik := expectation(points, model)
    real64[] trace := [loglik]
    for: iteration < iterations
        model = maximization(points, records, kind, epsilon)
        records, densities, loglik = expectation(points, model)
        trace = trace.append(loglik)
    return (model, records, densities, trace)

import math

const real64 pi := 3.141592653589793

real64 determinant(real64[] cov)
    return cov[0] * cov[2] - cov[1] * cov[1]

real64 mahalanobis(real64[] point, real64[] mean, real64[] cov)
    dx := point[0] - mean[0]
    dy := point[1] - mean[1]
    return (cov[2] * dx * dx - 2.0 * cov[1] * dx * dy + cov[0] * dy * dy) / determinant(cov)

real64 log_density(real64[] point, real64[] component)
    first := math.log(component[0])
    constant := math.log(2.0 * pi)
    log_det := math.log(determinant(component[3:<6]))
    return first - constant - log_det / 2.0 - mahalanobis(point, component[1:<3], component[3:<6]) / 2.0

real64 arctangent(real64 value)
    invert := value > 1.0
    z := if invert then 1.0 / value else value
    reduce := z > 0.41421356237309503
    if reduce
        z = (z - 1.0) / (z + 1.0)
    squared := z * z
    power := z
    real64 total := 0.0
    for: j < 40
        total += power / real64(2 * j + 1)
        power *= -squared
    if reduce
        total += pi / 4.0
    return if invert then pi / 2.0 - total else total

real64 atan2(real64 vertical, real64 horizontal)
    if horizontal == 0.0
        return if vertical >= 0.0 then pi / 2.0 else -pi / 2.0
    ratio := vertical / horizontal
    result := arctangent(if ratio < 0.0 then -ratio else ratio)
    if ratio < 0.0
        result = -result
    if horizontal < 0.0
        result += if vertical >= 0.0 then pi else -pi
    return result

real64[] eigen(real64[] cov)
    a := cov[0]
    b := cov[1]
    c := cov[2]
    h := (a + c) / 2.0
    delta := (a - c) / 2.0
    g := math.sqrt(delta * delta + b * b)
    leading := h + g
    trailing := h - g
    real64 ux := 1.0
    real64 uy := 0.0
    if b == 0.0
        if a < c
            ux = 0.0
            uy = 1.0
    else
        vx := if a >= c then leading - c else b
        vy := if a >= c then b else leading - a
        length := math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy)
        ux = vx / length
        uy = vy / length
        if vx < 0.0
            ux = -ux
            uy = -uy
    angle := atan2(uy, ux) * 180.0 / pi
    first_axis := math.sqrt(leading)
    second_axis := math.sqrt(trailing)
    real64 area := pi * math.sqrt(leading * trailing)
    real64 correlation := b / math.sqrt(a * c)
    return [leading, trailing, ux, uy, angle, first_axis, second_axis, area, correlation]

real64[] bhattacharyya(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    cov := [(first[3] + second[3]) / 2.0, (first[4] + second[4]) / 2.0, (first[5] + second[5]) / 2.0]
    real64 ratio := determinant(cov) / math.sqrt(determinant(first[3:<6]) * determinant(second[3:<6]))
    logarithm := math.log(ratio)
    distance := mahalanobis(second[1:<3], first[1:<3], cov) / 8.0 + logarithm / 2.0
    coefficient := math.exp(-distance)
    return [distance, coefficient]

import math

real64 distance2(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    dx := first[0] - second[0]
    dy := first[1] - second[1]
    return dx * dx + dy * dy

real64 distance(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    result := math.sqrt(distance2(first, second))
    return result

int[] assign(real64[][] points, real64[][] centers)
    int[] labels := []
    for point := points[]
        chosen := 0
        real64 best := inf
        for: k < int(#centers)
            candidate := distance2(point, centers[k])
            if candidate < best
                chosen = k
                best = candidate
        labels = labels.append(chosen)
    return labels

(real64[][], int[], int, real64, int[]) run(real64[][] points, real64[][] initial, int maximum)
    centers := initial
    labels := assign(points, centers)
    iterations := 0
    for: 1 <= iteration <= maximum
        real64[][] updated := []
        for: k < int(#centers)
            real64 sx := 0.0
            real64 sy := 0.0
            count := 0
            for: i < int(#points)
                if labels[i] == k
                    sx += points[i][0]
                    sy += points[i][1]
                    count += 1
            real64[] center := if count == 0 then centers[k] else [sx / real64(count), sy / real64(count)]
            updated = updated.append(center)
        centers = updated
        next_labels := assign(points, centers)
        same := labels == next_labels
        labels = next_labels
        iterations = iteration
        if same
            break
    real64 inertia := 0.0
    sizes := [for k := (0:<int(#centers))[] then 0]
    for: i < int(#points)
        sizes[labels[i]] += 1
        inertia += distance2(points[i], centers[labels[i]])
    return (centers, labels, iterations, inertia, sizes)

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import gaussian = "./gaussian.qui"
import em = "./em.qui"
import kmeans = "./kmeans.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

int winner(real64[] row)
    best := 0
    for: 1 <= k < int(#row)
        if row[k] > row[best]
            best = k
    return best

real64 row_entropy(real64[] row)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for value := row[]
        if value > 0.0
            logarithm := math.log(value)
            total += value * logarithm
    return -total

int parameter_count(int count, string kind)
    if kind == "FULL"
        return 6 * count - 1
    if kind == "TIED"
        return 3 * count + 2
    if kind == "DIAG"
        return 5 * count - 1
    return 4 * count - 1

class Fitted(int count, string kind, int type_index, real64[][] model, real64[][] records, real64[] densities, real64[] trace, local real64 tolerance, local int sample_size)
    p := parameter_count(count, kind)
    real64 loglik := trace[-1]
    real64 bic := -2.0 * loglik + real64(p) * math.log(real64(sample_size))
    aic := -2.0 * loglik + 2.0 * real64(p)
    int[] labels := []
    int[] sizes := [for k := (0:<int(count))[] then 0]
    real64 entropy_value := 0.0
    for row := records[]
        chosen := winner(row)
        labels = labels.append(chosen)
        sizes[chosen] += 1
        entropy_value += row_entropy(row)
    icl := bic + 2.0 * entropy_value
    settled_at := int(#trace) - 1
    local position := int(#trace) - 1
    while position >= 0
        gap := trace[position] - loglik
        if (if gap < 0.0 then -gap else gap) > tolerance
            break
        settled_at = position
        position -= 1
    largest_t := 1
    real64 largest_value := -inf
    int[] violations := []
    for: 1 <= t < int(#trace)
        increase := trace[t] - trace[t - 1]
        if increase > largest_value
            largest_t = t
            largest_value = increase
        previous := trace[t - 1]
        if trace[t] < previous - 0.000001 * (if previous < 0.0 then -previous else previous)
            violations = violations.append(t)

Fitted fit(real64[][] points, real64[][] initial, int count, string kind, int type_index, dataset.Settings settings)
    model, records, densities, trace := em.run(points, initial, kind, settings.iterations, settings.epsilon)
    return Fitted(count, kind, type_index, model, records, densities, trace, settings.tolerance, int(#points))

real64 criterion_value(Fitted model, int criterion)
    return if criterion == 0 then model.bic elif criterion == 1 then model.aic else model.icl

bool model_before(Fitted first, Fitted second, int criterion)
    a := report.scaled(criterion_value(first, criterion))
    b := report.scaled(criterion_value(second, criterion))
    if a != b
        return a < b
    if first.p != second.p
        return first.p < second.p
    if first.count != second.count
        return first.count < second.count
    return first.type_index < second.type_index

Fitted[] ranking(Fitted[] source, int criterion)
    Fitted[] result := []
    for model := source[]
        index := 0
        while index < int(#result) and not model_before(model, result[index], criterion)
            index += 1
        Fitted[] updated := []
        for: j < int(#result)
            if j == index
                updated = updated.append(model)
            updated = updated.append(result[j])
        if index == int(#result)
            updated = updated.append(model)
        result = updated
    return result

Fitted[] by_count(Fitted[] source, int target)
    return [for model := source[] if model.count == target then model]

Fitted[] by_kind(Fitted[] source, string target)
    return [for model := source[] if model.kind == target then model]

int rank_position(Fitted[] source, Fitted target)
    for: j < int(#source)
        if source[j].count == target.count and source[j].type_index == target.type_index
            return j + 1
    return 0

int[][] contingency(int[] first, int[] second, int rows, int columns)
    result := [for a := (0:<int(rows))[] then [for b := (0:<int(columns))[] then 0]]
    for: i < int(#first)
        result[first[i]][second[i]] += 1
    return result

int choose2(int count)
    return count * (count - 1) / 2

int gcd(int first, int second)
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return first

string ari(int[] first, int[] second, int rows, int columns)
    matrix := contingency(first, second, rows, columns)
    shared := 0
    a := 0
    b := 0
    for row := matrix[]
        total := 0
        for value := row[]
            shared += choose2(value)
            total += value
        a += choose2(total)
    for: column < columns
        total := 0
        for: row < rows
            total += matrix[row][column]
        b += choose2(total)
    z := choose2(int(#first))
    numerator := 2 * (z * shared - a * b)
    denominator := z * (a + b) - 2 * a * b
    if denominator == 0
        numerator = 1
        denominator = 1
    else
        if denominator < 0
            numerator = -numerator
            denominator = -denominator
        divisor := gcd(if numerator < 0 then -numerator else numerator, denominator)
        numerator /= divisor
        denominator /= divisor
    return "{numerator}/{denominator} " + report.dec(real64(numerator) / real64(denominator))

class Metrics(bool valid, real64 silhouette, real64 ch, real64 db, real64[] cluster)

Metrics partition_metrics(real64[][] points, int[] labels, int count)
    sample_size := int(#points)
    sizes := [for k := (0:<int(count))[] then 0]
    real64[][] centers := [for k := (0:<int(count))[] then [0.0, 0.0]]
    int[] occupied := []
    real64[] center := [0.0, 0.0]
    for point := points[]
        center[0] += point[0]
        center[1] += point[1]
    center[0] /= real64(sample_size)
    center[1] /= real64(sample_size)
    for: k < count
        for: i < sample_size
            if labels[i] == k
                sizes[k] += 1
                centers[k][0] += points[i][0]
                centers[k][1] += points[i][1]
        if sizes[k] > 0
            occupied = occupied.append(k)
            centers[k][0] /= real64(sizes[k])
            centers[k][1] /= real64(sizes[k])
    real64[] cluster := [for k := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]
    if #occupied < 2
        return Metrics(false, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, cluster)
    real64 silhouette := 0.0
    for: i < sample_size
        own := labels[i]
        real64 own_sum := 0.0
        real64 nearest := inf
        for k := occupied[]
            real64 total := 0.0
            for: j < sample_size
                if labels[j] == k and j != i
                    total += kmeans.distance(points[i], points[j])
            if k == own
                own_sum = total
            elif total / real64(sizes[k]) < nearest
                nearest = total / real64(sizes[k])
        real64 score := 0.0
        if sizes[own] > 1
            a := own_sum / real64(sizes[own] - 1)
            score = (nearest - a) / (if a > nearest then a else nearest)
        silhouette += score
        cluster[own] += score
    real64 between := 0.0
    real64 within := 0.0
    real64[] scatter := [for k := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]
    for k := occupied[]
        cluster[k] /= real64(sizes[k])
        between += real64(sizes[k]) * kmeans.distance2(centers[k], center)
        for: i < sample_size
            if labels[i] == k
                scatter[k] += kmeans.distance(points[i], centers[k])
        scatter[k] /= real64(sizes[k])
    for: i < sample_size
        within += kmeans.distance2(points[i], centers[labels[i]])
    groups := int(#occupied)
    ch := (between / real64(groups - 1)) / (within / real64(sample_size - groups))
    real64 db := 0.0
    for k := occupied[]
        real64 worst := -inf
        for other := occupied[]
            if other != k
                candidate := (scatter[k] + scatter[other]) / kmeans.distance(centers[k], centers[other])
                if candidate > worst
                    worst = candidate
        db += worst
    return Metrics(true, silhouette / real64(sample_size), ch, db / real64(groups), cluster)

string metric_text(Metrics stats, int key)
    if not stats.valid
        return "-"
    return report.dec(if key == 0 then stats.silhouette elif key == 1 then stats.ch else stats.db)

class Means(real64[][] centers, int[] labels, int iterations, real64 inertia, int[] sizes)

(real64, int[]) cluster_statistics(int[][] clusters, real64[][] records)
    real64 total := 0.0
    sizes := [for j := (0:<int(#clusters))[] then 0]
    for row := records[]
        real64[] probabilities := []
        for cluster := clusters[]
            real64 probability := 0.0
            for k := cluster[]
                probability += row[k]
            probabilities = probabilities.append(probability)
        total += row_entropy(probabilities)
        sizes[winner(probabilities)] += 1
    return (total, sizes)

int[][] merge_clusters(int[][] source, int first, int second)
    int[][] result := []
    for: j < int(#source)
        if j == second
            continue
        cluster := source[j]
        if j == first
            cluster = cluster.concat(source[second]).sorted()
        result = result.append(cluster)
    return result

string cluster_name(int[] cluster)
    return [for k := cluster[] then string(k + 1)].join("+")

int[][] permutations(int[] prefix, int count)
    if int(#prefix) == count
        return [prefix]
    int[][] result := []
    for: k < count
        used := false
        for value := prefix[]
            if value == k
                used = true
        if not used
            result = result.concat(permutations(prefix.append(k), count))
    return result

class Analysis(dataset.Input data)
    Fitted[] models := []
    Means[] means := []
    Fitted[] bic_ranked := []
    Fitted[] aic_ranked := []
    Fitted[] icl_ranked := []
    string[][] selection_blocks := []

    void .estimate()
        for count := data.settings.ks[]
            centers := [for component := data.initial[count][] then component[1:<3]]
            final_centers, labels, iterations, inertia, sizes := kmeans.run(data.points, centers, data.settings.kmeans_iterations)
            means = means.append(Means(final_centers, labels, iterations, inertia, sizes))
            for: type_index < int(#data.settings.types)
                string kind := data.settings.types[type_index]
                models = models.append(fit(data.points, data.initial[count], count, kind, type_index, data.settings))
        bic_ranked = ranking(models, 0)
        aic_ranked = ranking(models, 1)
        icl_ranked = ranking(models, 2)

    int means_index(int count)
        for: j < int(#data.settings.ks)
            if data.settings.ks[j] == count
                return j
        return 0

    void model_files()
        string[][] blocks := []
        trace_lines := ["K,type,iteration,loglik"]
        for fitted := models[]
            block := ["model K={fitted.count} type={fitted.kind}", "parameters {fitted.p}", "loglik " + report.dec(fitted.loglik), "bic " + report.dec(fitted.bic), "aic " + report.dec(fitted.aic), "icl " + report.dec(fitted.icl), "mean_entropy " + report.dec(fitted.entropy_value / real64(#data.points)), "settled_at {fitted.settled_at}", "largest_increase iteration {fitted.largest_t} value " + report.dec(fitted.largest_value), "violations {#fitted.violations}", "sizes " + report.integers(fitted.sizes)]
            for: k < fitted.count
                component := fitted.model[k]
                geometry := gaussian.eigen(component[3:<6])
                block = block.append("component {k + 1} weight " + report.dec(component[0]) + " mean " + report.values(component[1:<3]) + " cov " + report.values(component[3:<6]) + " axes " + report.values(geometry[5:<7]) + " angle " + report.dec(geometry[4]))
            blocks = blocks.append(block)
            for: t < int(#fitted.trace)
                trace_lines = trace_lines.append("{fitted.count},{fitted.kind},{t}," + report.dec(fitted.trace[t]))
        report.write_blocks("models.txt", blocks)
        report.write_lines("loglik_trace.csv", trace_lines)
        selected := bic_ranked[0]
        km := means[means_index(selected.count)]
        assignments := ["id,component,max_responsibility,log_density,kmeans_cluster"]
        for: i < int(#data.points)
            maximum := selected.records[i][winner(selected.records[i])]
            assignments = assignments.append("{data.ids[i]},{selected.labels[i] + 1}," + report.dec(maximum) + "," + report.dec(selected.densities[i]) + ",{km.labels[i] + 1}")
        report.write_lines("assignments.csv", assignments)

    void .rankings_and_partitions()
        selected := bic_ranked[0]
        block := ["ranking by bic", "rank K type parameters loglik bic delta_bic aic aic_rank icl icl_rank"]
        for: j < int(#bic_ranked)
            fitted := bic_ranked[j]
            delta := real64(report.scaled(fitted.bic) - report.scaled(selected.bic)) / 10000.0
            block = block.append("{j + 1} {fitted.count} {fitted.kind} {fitted.p} " + report.dec(fitted.loglik) + " " + report.dec(fitted.bic) + " " + report.dec(delta) + " " + report.dec(fitted.aic) + " {rank_position(aic_ranked, fitted)} " + report.dec(fitted.icl) + " {rank_position(icl_ranked, fitted)}")
        block = block.concat(["selected K={selected.count} type={selected.kind}", "best_aic K={aic_ranked[0].count} type={aic_ranked[0].kind}", "best_icl K={icl_ranked[0].count} type={icl_ranked[0].kind}"])
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)
        block = ["best K per type"]
        for kind := data.settings.types[]
            subset := by_kind(models, kind)
            block = block.append("{kind} bic {ranking(subset, 0)[0].count} aic {ranking(subset, 1)[0].count} icl {ranking(subset, 2)[0].count}")
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)
        Fitted[] best_models := []
        for: index < int(#data.settings.ks)
            int count := data.settings.ks[index]
            best := ranking(by_count(models, count), 0)[0]
            best_models = best_models.append(best)
            km := means[index]
            gm_stats := partition_metrics(data.points, best.labels, count)
            km_stats := partition_metrics(data.points, km.labels, count)
            block = ["K={count} type={best.kind} bic " + report.dec(best.bic), "  kmeans iterations {km.iterations} inertia " + report.dec(km.inertia), "  ari " + ari(best.labels, km.labels, count, count), "  silhouette gmm " + metric_text(gm_stats, 0) + " kmeans " + metric_text(km_stats, 0), "  calinski_harabasz gmm " + metric_text(gm_stats, 1) + " kmeans " + metric_text(km_stats, 1), "  davies_bouldin gmm " + metric_text(gm_stats, 2) + " kmeans " + metric_text(km_stats, 2)]
            if index > 0
                previous := best_models[index - 1]
                matrix := contingency(previous.labels, best.labels, previous.count, count)
                string[] parents := []
                int[] shares := []
                for: k < count
                    chosen := -1
                    largest := 0
                    for: a < previous.count
                        if matrix[a][k] > largest
                            largest = matrix[a][k]
                            chosen = a
                    parents = parents.append(if chosen < 0 then "-" else string(chosen + 1))
                    shares = shares.append(largest)
                block = block.append("  parents K={previous.count} " + parents.join(" ") + " shared " + report.integers(shares))
            selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)
        block = ["violations"]
        for fitted := models[]
            for t := fitted.violations[]
                block = block.append("K={fitted.count} type={fitted.kind} iteration {t} previous " + report.dec(fitted.trace[t - 1]) + " current " + report.dec(fitted.trace[t]))
        if #block == 1
            block = block.append("none")
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)

    void .components_and_overlap()
        selected := bic_ranked[0]
        stats := partition_metrics(data.points, selected.labels, selected.count)
        block := ["selected components"]
        for: k < selected.count
            component := selected.model[k]
            geometry := gaussian.eigen(component[3:<6])
            observed := [for j := (0:<int(int(#data.settings.edges) + 1))[] then 0]
            real64 soft := 0.0
            inside_one := 0
            inside_two := 0
            for: i < int(#data.points)
                soft += selected.records[i][k]
                if selected.labels[i] == k
                    q := gaussian.mahalanobis(data.points[i], component[1:<3], component[3:<6])
                    if q <= 1.0
                        inside_one += 1
                    if q <= 4.0
                        inside_two += 1
                    rho := math.sqrt(q)
                    bucket := 0
                    while bucket < int(#data.settings.edges) and rho >= data.settings.edges[bucket]
                        bucket += 1
                    observed[bucket] += 1
            real64[] expected := []
            real64 left := 0.0
            real64 chi := 0.0
            for: j < int(#observed)
                real64 end_probability := 0.0
                if j < int(#data.settings.edges)
                    real64 right := data.settings.edges[j]
                    end_probability = math.exp(-right * right / 2.0)
                start_probability := math.exp(-left * left / 2.0)
                expectation := real64(selected.sizes[k]) * (start_probability - end_probability)
                expected = expected.append(expectation)
                delta := real64(observed[j]) - expectation
                chi += delta * delta / expectation
                if j < int(#data.settings.edges)
                    left = data.settings.edges[j]
            block = block.append("component {k + 1} weight " + report.dec(component[0]) + " size {selected.sizes[k]} soft_size " + report.dec(soft) + " mean " + report.values(component[1:<3]))
            block = block.append("  cov " + report.values(component[3:<6]) + " corr " + report.dec(geometry[8]))
            block = block.append("  eigen " + report.values(geometry[0:<2]) + " direction " + report.values(geometry[2:<4]) + " angle " + report.dec(geometry[4]))
            block = block.append("  axes_1sigma " + report.values(geometry[5:<7]) + " axes_2sigma " + report.values([2.0 * geometry[5], 2.0 * geometry[6]]))
            block = block.append("  inside_1sigma {inside_one} inside_2sigma {inside_two} area_1sigma " + report.dec(geometry[7]))
            block = block.append("  silhouette " + (if stats.valid and selected.sizes[k] > 0 then report.dec(stats.cluster[k]) else "-"))
            block = block.append("  gof observed " + report.integers(observed) + " expected " + report.values(expected) + " chi2 " + report.dec(chi))
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)
        block = ["overlap"]
        for: first < selected.count - 1
            for: first + 1 <= second < selected.count
                overlap := gaussian.bhattacharyya(selected.model[first], selected.model[second])
                real64 shared := 0.0
                for row := selected.records[]
                    shared += row[first] * row[second]
                block = block.append("{first + 1}-{second + 1} bhattacharyya " + report.dec(overlap[0]) + " coefficient " + report.dec(overlap[1]) + " shared " + report.dec(shared))
        if #block == 1
            block = block.append("none")
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)

    void .merging()
        selected := bic_ranked[0]
        int[][] clusters := [for k := (0:<int(selected.count))[] then [k]]
        start_entropy, initial_sizes := cluster_statistics(clusters, selected.records)
        block := ["merging", "start entropy " + report.dec(start_entropy)]
        step := 0
        while #clusters > 1
            int[][] best := []
            first := -1
            second := -1
            real64 best_entropy := inf
            int[] best_sizes := []
            for: a < int(#clusters) - 1
                for: a + 1 <= b < int(#clusters)
                    proposed := merge_clusters(clusters, a, b)
                    total, sizes := cluster_statistics(proposed, selected.records)
                    if first < 0 or report.scaled(total) < report.scaled(best_entropy)
                        best = proposed
                        first = a
                        second = b
                        best_entropy = total
                        best_sizes = sizes
            step += 1
            block = block.append("step {step} merge " + cluster_name(clusters[first]) + " " + cluster_name(clusters[second]) + " entropy " + report.dec(best_entropy) + " sizes " + report.integers(best_sizes))
            clusters = best
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)

    void .kmeans_comparison_and_refit()
        selected := bic_ranked[0]
        km := means[means_index(selected.count)]
        sample_size := int(#data.points)
        matrix := contingency(selected.labels, km.labels, selected.count, selected.count)
        int[] best_permutation := []
        agreement := -1
        for permutation := permutations([], selected.count)[]
            total := 0
            for: j < selected.count
                total += matrix[permutation[j]][j]
            if total > agreement
                agreement = total
                best_permutation = permutation
        block := ["kmeans K={selected.count}", "iterations {km.iterations}", "inertia " + report.dec(km.inertia), "sizes " + report.integers(km.sizes)]
        for: k < selected.count
            block = block.append("center {k + 1} " + report.values(km.centers[k]))
        block = block.append("contingency")
        for row := matrix[]
            block = block.append(report.integers(row))
        block = block.append("ari " + ari(selected.labels, km.labels, selected.count, selected.count))
        block = block.append("matching " + report.integers([for k := best_permutation[] then k + 1]))
        block = block.append("agreement {agreement}/{sample_size} " + report.dec(real64(agreement) / real64(sample_size)))
        disagreements := 0
        for: i < sample_size
            cluster := km.labels[i]
            if best_permutation[cluster] != selected.labels[i]
                disagreements += 1
                maximum := selected.records[i][winner(selected.records[i])]
                block = block.append("disagree {data.ids[i]} gmm {selected.labels[i] + 1} kmeans {cluster + 1} max " + report.dec(maximum))
        block = block.append("disagreements {disagreements}")
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)
        real64[][] initial := []
        for: k < selected.count
            real64 a := 0.0
            real64 b := 0.0
            real64 c := 0.0
            for: i < sample_size
                if km.labels[i] == k
                    dx := data.points[i][0] - km.centers[k][0]
                    dy := data.points[i][1] - km.centers[k][1]
                    a += dx * dx
                    b += dx * dy
                    c += dy * dy
            size := real64(km.sizes[k])
            initial = initial.append([size / real64(sample_size), km.centers[k][0], km.centers[k][1], a / size + data.settings.epsilon, b / size, c / size + data.settings.epsilon])
        refit := fit(data.points, initial, selected.count, selected.kind, selected.type_index, data.settings)
        block = ["refit_from_kmeans K={selected.count} type={selected.kind}", "loglik " + report.dec(refit.loglik) + " bic " + report.dec(refit.bic) + " settled_at {refit.settled_at}", "sizes " + report.integers(refit.sizes), "ari_vs_selected " + ari(selected.labels, refit.labels, selected.count, selected.count)]
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)

    void .cross_validation()
        selected := bic_ranked[0]
        int folds := data.settings.folds
        block := ["cross_validation K={selected.count} type={selected.kind} folds {folds}"]
        real64 total := 0.0
        for: fold < folds
            real64[][] training := []
            real64[][] testing := []
            for: i < int(#data.points)
                if i % folds == fold
                    testing = testing.append(data.points[i])
                else
                    training = training.append(data.points[i])
            model, records, densities, trace := em.run(training, data.initial[selected.count], selected.kind, data.settings.iterations, data.settings.epsilon)
            test_records, test_densities, test_total := em.expectation(testing, model)
            real64 train_loglik := trace[-1] / real64(#training)
            real64 test_loglik := test_total / real64(#testing)
            total += test_loglik
            block = block.append("fold {fold + 1} train {#training} test {#testing} train_loglik " + report.dec(train_loglik) + " test_loglik " + report.dec(test_loglik))
        block = block.append("mean_test_loglik " + report.dec(total / real64(folds)))
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)

    int[] point_order(Fitted selected, bool uncertain_points)
        int[] result := []
        for: i < int(#data.points)
            score := if uncertain_points then selected.records[i][winner(selected.records[i])] else selected.densities[i]
            real64 threshold := if uncertain_points then data.settings.uncertain else data.settings.low_density
            if score >= threshold
                continue
            key := report.scaled(score)
            int[] updated := []
            added := false
            for previous := result[]
                previous_score := if uncertain_points then selected.records[previous][winner(selected.records[previous])] else selected.densities[previous]
                if not added and key < report.scaled(previous_score)
                    updated = updated.append(i)
                    added = true
                updated = updated.append(previous)
            if not added
                updated = updated.append(i)
            result = updated
        return result

    void .uncertain_and_outliers()
        selected := bic_ranked[0]
        int[] uncertain := point_order(selected, true)
        block := ["uncertain threshold " + report.dec(data.settings.uncertain)]
        for i := uncertain[]
            row := selected.records[i]
            block = block.append("{data.ids[i]} component {selected.labels[i] + 1} max " + report.dec(row[winner(row)]) + " responsibilities " + report.values(row))
        block = block.append("count {#uncertain}")
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)
        int[] outliers := point_order(selected, false)
        block = ["outliers threshold " + report.dec(data.settings.low_density)]
        for i := outliers[]
            k := selected.labels[i]
            q := gaussian.mahalanobis(data.points[i], selected.model[k][1:<3], selected.model[k][3:<6])
            block = block.append("{data.ids[i]} component {k + 1} log_density " + report.dec(selected.densities[i]) + " q " + report.dec(q))
        block = block.append("count {#outliers}")
        selection_blocks = selection_blocks.append(block)

    int[] map_cell(real64[] point)
        real64 dx := (data.settings.xmax - data.settings.xmin) / real64(data.settings.width)
        real64 dy := (data.settings.ymax - data.settings.ymin) / real64(data.settings.height)
        column := math.floor((point[0] - data.settings.xmin) / dx)
        row := math.floor((data.settings.ymax - point[1]) / dy)
        return [int(column), int(row)]

    bool valid_cell(int[] cell)
        return 0 <= cell[0] < data.settings.width and 0 <= cell[1] < data.settings.height

    string[] map_rows(string[][] grid)
        return [for row := grid[] then row.join("")]

    void map_file()
        selected := bic_ranked[0]
        dataset.Settings settings := data.settings
        width := settings.width
        height := settings.height
        dx := (settings.xmax - settings.xmin) / real64(width)
        dy := (settings.ymax - settings.ymin) / real64(height)
        real64[][][] coordinates := []
        real64[][] densities := []
        real64[][][] responsibilities := []
        int[][] winners := []
        real64 maximum := 0.0
        real64 mass := 0.0
        for: row < height
            real64[][] coordinate_row := []
            real64[] density_row := []
            real64[][] responsibility_row := []
            int[] winner_row := []
            for: column < width
                point := [settings.xmin + (real64(column) + 0.5) * dx, settings.ymax - (real64(row) + 0.5) * dy]
                coordinate_row = coordinate_row.append(point)
                real64[] scores := []
                real64 density := 0.0
                real64 max_score := -inf
                for component := selected.model[]
                    score := gaussian.log_density(point, component)
                    scores = scores.append(score)
                    term := math.exp(score)
                    density += term
                    if score > max_score
                        max_score = score
                real64[] probabilities := []
                real64 normalizer := 0.0
                for score := scores[]
                    term := math.exp(score - max_score)
                    probabilities = probabilities.append(term)
                    normalizer += term
                for &probability := &probabilities[]
                    probability /= normalizer
                density_row = density_row.append(density)
                responsibility_row = responsibility_row.append(probabilities)
                winner_row = winner_row.append(winner(scores))
                if density > maximum
                    maximum = density
                mass += density
            coordinates = coordinates.append(coordinate_row)
            densities = densities.append(density_row)
            responsibilities = responsibilities.append(responsibility_row)
            winners = winners.append(winner_row)
        density_map := [for row := (int(0):<int(height))[] then [for column := (int(0):<int(width))[] then " "]]
        region_map := density_map
        uncertainty_map := density_map
        point_map := density_map
        level_counts := [for level := (0:<10)[] then 0]
        for: row < height
            for: column < width
                raw := math.floor(10.0 * densities[row][column] / maximum)
                level := int(raw)
                if level > 9
                    level = 9
                level_counts[level] += 1
                density_map[row][column] = report.levels[level]
                region_map[row][column] = string(winners[row][column] + 1)
                uncertainty_level := 0
                if selected.count >= 2
                    denominator := math.log(real64(selected.count))
                    scaled_entropy := math.floor(10.0 * row_entropy(responsibilities[row][column]) / denominator)
                    uncertainty_level = int(scaled_entropy)
                    if uncertainty_level < 0
                        uncertainty_level = 0
                    elif uncertainty_level > 9
                        uncertainty_level = 9
                uncertainty_map[row][column] = report.levels[uncertainty_level]
                contour := false
                for component := selected.model[]
                    if gaussian.mahalanobis(coordinates[row][column], component[1:<3], component[3:<6]) > 4.0
                        continue
                    for offset := [[0, -1], [0, 1], [-1, 0], [1, 0]][]
                        int[] neighbor := [column + offset[0], row + offset[1]]
                        if valid_cell(neighbor) and gaussian.mahalanobis(coordinates[neighbor[1]][neighbor[0]], component[1:<3], component[3:<6]) > 4.0
                            contour = true
                            break
                    if contour
                        break
                point_map[row][column] = if contour then "." else " "
        for: k < selected.count
            int[] cell := map_cell(selected.model[k][1:<3])
            if valid_cell(cell)
                density_map[cell[1]][cell[0]] = string(k + 1)
        bins := [for row := (int(0):<int(height))[] then [for column := (int(0):<int(width))[] then -1]]
        outside := 0
        for: i < int(#data.points)
            int[] cell := map_cell(data.points[i])
            if not valid_cell(cell)
                outside += 1
                continue
            previous := bins[cell[1]][cell[0]]
            if previous == -1
                bins[cell[1]][cell[0]] = selected.labels[i]
            elif previous != selected.labels[i]
                bins[cell[1]][cell[0]] = -2
        for: row < height
            for: column < width
                component := bins[row][column]
                if component == -2
                    point_map[row][column] = "*"
                elif component >= 0
                    point_map[row][column] = string(component + 1)
        rows := ["density K={selected.count} type={selected.kind}", "x " + report.dec(settings.xmin) + " " + report.dec(settings.xmax) + " y " + report.dec(settings.ymin) + " " + report.dec(settings.ymax) + " grid {width}x{height}", "max_density " + report.dec(maximum, 6) + " mass_in_map " + report.dec(mass * dx * dy)]
        rows = rows.concat(report.framed(map_rows(density_map)))
        for: level < 10
            rows = rows.append("level {level} {DQ}{report.levels[level]}{DQ} from " + report.dec(real64(level) * maximum / 10.0, 6) + " cells {level_counts[level]}")
        rows = rows.concat(["", "regions"]).concat(report.framed(map_rows(region_map)))
        rows = rows.concat(["", "uncertainty"]).concat(report.framed(map_rows(uncertainty_map)))
        rows = rows.concat(["", "points"]).concat(report.framed(map_rows(point_map)))
        rows = rows.append("outside {outside}")
        report.write_lines("density_map.txt", rows)

    void .run()
        .estimate()
        model_files()
        .rankings_and_partitions()
        .components_and_overlap()
        .merging()
        .kmeans_comparison_and_refit()
        .cross_validation()
        .uncertain_and_outliers()
        report.write_blocks("selection.txt", selection_blocks)
        map_file()

void run()
    analysis := Analysis(dataset.read_inputs())
    .analysis.run()

run()

import math

const levels := " .:-=+*#%@"

int power10(int places)
    result := 1
    for: j < places
        result *= 10
    return result

int scaled(real64 value, places := 4)
    absolute := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    rounded := math.floor(absolute * real64(power10(places)) + 0.5)
    result := int(rounded)
    return if value < 0.0 then -result else result

string dec(real64 value, places := 4)
    rounded := scaled(value, places)
    sign := if rounded < 0 then "-" else ""
    magnitude := if rounded < 0 then -rounded else rounded
    scale := power10(places)
    tail := string(magnitude % scale)
    return sign + string(magnitude / scale) + "." + "0" * nat(places - int(#tail)) + tail

string optional(real64 | none value)
    match value
        real64 present
            return dec(present)
        none
            return "-"

string integers(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then string(value)].join(" ")

string values(real64[] numbers)
    return [for value := numbers[] then dec(value)].join(" ")

string[] framed(string[] grid)
    string border := "+" + "-" * #grid[0] + "+"
    rows := [border]
    for row := grid[]
        rows = rows.append("|" + row + "|")
    return rows.append(border)

void write_lines(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(rows.join(NL) + NL)

void write_blocks(string name, string[][] blocks)
    string[] rows := []
    for: j < int(#blocks)
        if j > 0
            rows = rows.append("")
        rows = rows.concat(blocks[j])
    write_lines(name, rows)
